prompt: Inspect the battery assembly tray in this night-vision camera image. Four rectangular battery modules should be present, seated, and aligned side by side in the tray. Reply G if all four are visibly present, seated, and aligned; R if a module is visibly missing, raised, or misaligned; or A if occlusion or image quality prevents a reliable inspection. Reply with exactly one letter: G, A, or R.

G.name: normal
G.meaning: All four modules visibly present, seated, and aligned.

A.name: insufficient_evidence
A.meaning: Occlusion or image quality prevents reliable inspection.

R.name: visible_anomaly
R.meaning: A module is visibly missing, raised, or misaligned.
